title: Certification transferability unconfirmed while load-bearing for the deal thesis
notes: declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). Same condition also declared in greenfield-pre-fs (separate registry entry). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: cert.load_bearing_unconfirmed (count: load_bearing=1 AND transferability_basis IS NULL) — distinct from cert.load_bearing_non_transferable_on_coc, which counts confirmed-'no' rows, not unconfirmed ones.
